pairs.question: Quadrupes tardigrada, agrestis, humilis, aspera. Testudinem Pacuuianam putas?
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical: the riddling verse line (stripped of its standalone-quote layout) is kept as setup so 'Testudinem... putas?' has a referent; the author asks and answers himself. Answer cut at the first full stop ('Non est.'); what follows ('Capit et alia bestiola uersiculum...') elaborates by naming the chameleon and does not answer the question, so it is omitted.
